name: miniOrange Amazon Integration for WooCommerce
author: miniOrange

sections.description:
WooCommerce to Amazon Plugin turns your store into a multichannel selling platform. This Amazon WooCommerce integration plugin helps you connect WooCommerce to Amazon by syncing products, inventory, and orders in real time. With seamless WooCommerce and Amazon integration, you can easily link WooCommerce to Amazon and manage your WooCommerce store and Amazon from one centralized dashboard, ensuring accurate WooCommerce Amazon sync.

Sync your WooCommerce store with Amazon to maintain accurate stock levels, automate order syncing, and manage product listings without manual updates. This WooCommerce Amazon integration plugin enables real-time WooCommerce Amazon sync, helps prevent overselling, reduces operational errors, and delivers a smooth selling experience for both store owners and customers by allowing you to connect WooCommerce to Amazon from one centralized system.

The Amazon WooCommerce integration plugin supports bulk product uploads, flexible product field mapping, and seamless WooCommerce Amazon sync for orders. Once synced, Amazon orders are automatically imported into WooCommerce as standard orders, allowing you to manage Amazon and WooCommerce orders from one dashboard and efficiently handle fulfillment, tracking, and reporting without switching platforms or manually updating data.

Features

Real-Time WooCommerce Amazon Sync: Automatically connect WooCommerce and Amazon to sync products, pricing, and inventory in real time. Stock levels update instantly across both platforms after every sale, helping prevent overselling and inventory mismatches.

  • WooCommerce to Amazon Product Sync: Easily link WooCommerce to Amazon and list products using bulk uploads. Maintain consistent titles, descriptions, prices, SKUs, and product details across channels without manual updates.

  • Flexible Product Field Mapping: Customize field mapping between WooCommerce and Amazon product attributes to meet Amazon listing requirements. This improves listing accuracy, ensures smoother approvals, and strengthens your WooCommerce and Amazon integration.

  • Automatic Amazon Order Sync: Seamlessly import Amazon orders into WooCommerce using real-time WooCommerce Amazon sync. Orders appear as native WooCommerce orders with complete customer details, items, quantities, pricing, and fulfillment method (FBA or FBM).

  • Centralized Multichannel Order Management: Manage both WooCommerce and Amazon orders from a single dashboard. Track order status, fulfillment, and reports efficiently without switching platforms.

  • Bulk Product Uploads & Listing Management: Use the Amazon WooCommerce integration plugin to upload and publish multiple products to Amazon at once, saving time when onboarding or expanding your catalog.

  • Detailed Audit Logs & Sync Monitoring: Monitor product syncs, inventory updates, and order imports with detailed audit logs. Quickly identify and resolve issues while maintaining reliable WooCommerce Amazon integration.

  • Secure Amazon API Integration: Safely connect WooCommerce to Amazon using Amazon Seller APIs with secure authentication. All data transfers are encrypted and compliant with Amazon’s integration guidelines.

  • User-Friendly Setup & Configuration: Get started quickly with a guided setup wizard and intuitive interface. This WooCommerce Amazon integration plugin requires no coding or technical expertise.

Use Case

Multi-Channel Retailer Expanding to Amazon
If you run a WooCommerce store and want to expand your sales channel, this WooCommerce Amazon integration plugin makes it easy to connect WooCommerce to Amazon and reach a larger audience. With WooCommerce and Amazon integration, you can automate product syncing by mapping WooCommerce product fields such as SKU, price, and descriptions to Amazon’s required attributes. Use the bulk upload feature to list WooCommerce products on Amazon in just a few clicks.

  • Inventory Sync: With real-time WooCommerce Amazon sync, inventory levels are automatically updated across both WooCommerce and Amazon whenever a sale occurs. This prevents overselling and keeps stock data accurate across channels.

  • Order Sync: Amazon orders are automatically imported into WooCommerce, allowing you to manage them just like native WooCommerce orders. This smooth WooCommerce Amazon order sync eliminates manual imports and reduces operational effort.

Outcome: By linking WooCommerce to Amazon, you can confidently sell on multiple channels without inventory mismatches. All products and orders are managed from a single, centralized dashboard which saves time, reduces errors, and enables scalable growth on Amazon.

Upcoming Integrations

  • Connect WooCommerce with eBay – Connect with an eBay seller account to manage products and orders from WooCommerce
  • Connect WooCommerce with Walmart – Connect with a Walmart seller account to manage products and orders from WooCommerce
  • Connect WooCommerce with Etsy – Connect with an Etsy seller account to manage products and orders from WooCommerce

FREE PLAN

  • WooCommerce Amazon Product Sync
  • Flexible Product Field Mapping
  • Manual order sync of previous day
  • Bulk Product Uploads & Listing Management
  • Detailed Audit Logs & Sync Monitoring

PREMIUM PLAN

  • FREE PLAN+
  • Scheduling of product attributes (sync inventory/stock automatically)
  • Sync product variations between Amazon and WooCommerce
  • Schedule Order Sync from Amazon to WooCommerce
  • Update order shipment status from WooCommerce to Amazon
  • Auto-template mapping
  • Multi-region Amazon sync
  • Add margin percentage on price

Requirements

  • WooCommerce: Version 3.0 or higher.
  • WordPress: Version 6.0 or higher.
  • Access to Amazon Seller Account

External services

This plugin allows users to list products from WooCommerce to their Amazon seller account by connecting to the Amazon public APIs securely, and can also securely fetch Amazon orders from the authorised seller account to WooCommerce.
Below are the services this plugin utilises-

  • Amazon Seller – https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api
    Amazon Seller Terms of Use
    Amazon Seller Privacy Policy

  • Also, this plugin uses our service (miniOrange/xecurify.com) to authorise users to connect to their Amazon seller account securely. During this process, no data is stored on our end. All the data remains on the user’s end only.
    miniOrange (Xecurify) Terms of Use
    miniOrange (Xecurify) Privacy Policy

Important Notes

  • This plugin does not rely directly on Amazon to work; users can choose to securely connect to their Amazon seller account to manage the products and orders.
  • Additionally, the plugin may connect to login.xecurify.com if a user opts to register with miniOrange (our service). This is entirely optional.

Privacy

This plugin does not store any user data.

Support

If you need assistance, visit our support page at https://plugins.miniorange.com/woocommerce-amazon-integration, or contact us via email at apisupport@xecurify.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the multichannel-selling-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Connect your Amazon seller account and configure settings through the WooCommerce settings page.
  4. Begin syncing your products, inventory, and orders between WooCommerce and Amazon!
sections.faq:
What is WooCommerce Amazon Integration Plugin?

WooCommerce Amazon Integration is a plugin that connects your WooCommerce store with your Amazon seller account. It allows you to sync products, inventory, and orders automatically between WooCommerce and Amazon, helping you manage multichannel sales from one dashboard.

Does this plugin sync WooCommerce products to Amazon?

Yes. The plugin supports WooCommerce to Amazon product sync, allowing you to list products on Amazon in bulk or individually. Product data such as title, SKU, price, description, and stock quantity can be synced automatically.

How does Amazon inventory sync work?

Inventory levels are synced in real time between WooCommerce and Amazon. When a product is sold on either platform, the stock quantity is updated across both stores to prevent overselling and inventory mismatches.

Can Amazon orders be imported into WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin provides automatic Amazon order sync, importing Amazon orders directly into WooCommerce. Orders appear as standard WooCommerce orders and include items, quantities, prices, and fulfillment method (FBA or FBM).

Does the plugin support FBA and FBM orders?

Yes. Both Fulfilled by Amazon (FBA) and Fulfilled by Merchant (FBM) orders are supported and synced into WooCommerce for centralized order management.

Do I need technical knowledge to use this plugin?

No. The plugin is designed for beginners and non-technical users. It includes a simple setup process, guided configuration, and an easy-to-use interface.

Can I manage WooCommerce and Amazon orders from one place?

Yes. Once synced, Amazon orders are managed directly within WooCommerce alongside your store orders, allowing you to handle fulfillment, tracking, and reporting from a single dashboard.
